food_name: Broccoli cultivar group, I3C recovered after standardized myrosinase-generating extraction
food_database: Li et al. 2017, Table 2 and Results, ten broccoli cultivars
food_database_record_id: Ten CAAS/IVF broccoli cultivars harvested autumn 2015; mean across cultivars reported in Results
cultivar_or_variety: Ten cultivars; names/values tabulated in source Table 2
geographical_origin: Chinese Academy of Agricultural Science, Institute of Vegetables and Flowers field; China
synonym_verification_status: Exact analyte standard in source; Stage B structure identity checked
mapping_review_rationale: Source quantifies indole-3-carbinol against a >98% authentic standard with HPLC retention-time matching; Stage B CID/full InChIKey checked against PubChem. Manual exact identity mapping; Stage B was not edited.
moisture_basis: mg/kg dry weight; fresh broccoli/cabbage cultivars were freeze-dried before analysis; no fresh-weight conversion
analytical_method: HPLC-UV at 279 nm; >98% authentic I3C standard; retention time comparison; method linearity R²=0.9991 and reported recovery 99.25%
extraction_method: Freeze-dried, ground material incubated in buffer for 1.5 h to permit myrosinase-mediated I3C generation; ethyl acetate extraction repeated twice; solvent evaporated and residue re-dissolved in methanol
sample_size: n=10 broccoli cultivars; source reports average across varieties, not a market-sample mean
source_title: Development of a Simple Method for Determination of Anti-cancer Component of Indole-3-carbinol in Cabbage and Broccoli
database_reference: Results §3.5: broccoli mean I3C 34.34 mg/kg DW; ten cultivars ranged 8.88–65.47 mg/kg DW; Table 2 gives cultivar contents
extraction_notes: Promoted as an operational myrosinase-generated I3C yield from broccoli after standardized buffer extraction. The source reports average 34.34 mg/kg dry weight across ten broccoli cultivars (range 8.88–65.47). No cultivar-level average substituted for an individual cultivar measurement.
uncertainty_notes: NOT a direct measurement of pre-existing free I3C in intact fresh broccoli. It is generated/recovered under the paper’s controlled myrosinase extraction. Mean across 10 experimental cultivars; replicate level for each cultivar is not fully clear. Keep dry-weight basis; no dietary exposure estimate implied.
